level_reference 70
gen snowy_redwood_gusts
    prompt gentle gusts of wind brushing snow-laden redwood needles and flexible foliage, rounded airy swishes rising and easing naturally, no howling, no storm, no branch creaks, no snow impacts, dry recording, seamless ambience loop, consistent texture
    duration 30
    loopable

loop snowy_redwood_gusts
    source_id snowy_redwoods
    bed
    zone investigating
    move breathe
    spl 35
    visual none
    randomstart

loop snowy_redwood_gusts
    source_id snowy_redwoods_fight
    bed
    zone snowball_fight
    move breathe
    spl 33
    visual none
    randomstart

loop snowy_redwood_gusts
    source_id snowy_redwoods_chase
    bed
    zone chase
    move breathe
    spl 39
    visual none
    randomstart

loop snowy_redwood_gusts
    source_id snowy_redwoods_closed
    bed
    zone case_closed
    move breathe
    spl 30
    visual none
    randomstart

2 * loop falling-snow-ambience-2
    source_id snowfall_investigating
    zone investigating
    bed
    spl 25
    visual none
    randomstart

2 * loop falling-snow-ambience-2
    source_id snowfall_fight
    zone snowball_fight
    bed
    spl 22
    visual none
    randomstart

2 * loop falling-snow-ambience-2
    source_id snowfall_chase
    zone chase
    bed
    spl 25
    visual none
    randomstart

2 * loop falling-snow-ambience-2
    source_id snowfall_closed
    zone case_closed
    bed
    spl 23
    visual none
    randomstart

oneshot gen single snow-loaded wooden bough flexing with a short dry creak, no breaking every 55to110
    source_id redwood_branch
    radius 0.5
    zone investigating
    place -4 4 3
    move static
    spl 46
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

oneshot clump-snow-falling-pine-2 every 65to140
    source_id falling_snow_clump
    radius 0.4
    zone investigating
    place 4 0 2
    move static
    spl 43
    distance_model free_field_v1
    visual sphere

on step gen single footstep compressing fresh loose {text}, short cushioned crunch, dry recording
    source_id player_feedback
    spl 63
    cooldown 0.13
    variants 3
    visual sphere

# every kid's step: fired at that kid's feet
on kid_step gen single child's small winter boot stepping briskly into fresh loose {text}, compact granular crunch with a quick toe release, suitable for walking or running, dry recording
    source_id kid_steps
    spl 53
    cooldown 0.05
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 4
    visual trail

on scoop gen single gloved hand scooping and compressing loose {text} into a snowball, scrunchy granular squeeze, dry recording
    source_id player_feedback_scoop
    attach listener
    spl 57
    cooldown 0.16
    variants 3
    visual sphere

on kid_scoop gen single small wool-mittened hand gathering loose {text} with a short scraping sweep and squeezing it into a snowball, crunchy granular scrunch ending in a compact powdery press, dry recording
    source_id kid_scoop_contact
    spl 51
    cooldown 0.08
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on throw gen single snowball hand release, light short airy whoosh with glove friction, playful and natural, dry recording
    source_id snowball_release
    spl 55
    cooldown 0.06
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 3
    visual sphere

on snowball_hit gen single loose snowball bursting on a padded winter coat, powdery splat with a cushioned impact, playful and natural, dry recording
    source_id snowball_contact
    spl 58
    cooldown 0.05
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 4
    visual sphere

on snowball_hit_player gen single snowball bursting against a winter collar, broad powdery splat and padded thump, playful not painful, dry recording
    source_id player_feedback_hit
    attach listener
    spl 65
    cooldown 0.08
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on punch_hit gen single playful hand bop against a puffy winter coat, short padded fabric thump, no injury sound, dry recording
    source_id coat_bop
    spl 55
    cooldown 0.12
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on shutter gen single instant camera mechanical shutter clack, crisp compact plastic and metal mechanism, dry recording
    source_id player_feedback_shutter
    at polaroid_camera
    spl 64
    cooldown 0.15
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on print_eject gen single instant camera print ejection, small geared motor whirr lasting nine tenths of a second followed by a mechanical stop, dry recording
    source_id player_feedback_print
    at polaroid_camera
    spl 51
    cooldown 0.9
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on photo_drop gen single small instant photograph fluttering and landing on loose snow, brief papery flick and cushioned landing, dry recording
    source_id photo_landing
    spl 39
    cooldown 0.15
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

on kid_stunned gen single tiny cartoon seeing-stars twinkle, three delicate bright bell notes with a short decay
    source_id stunned_twinkle
    spl 48
    cooldown 0.6
    distance_model free_field_v1
    variants 2
    visual sphere

# satie-scene: Satie scene for Unity

18 sounds. Sound by Satie (https://www.satie.world): please keep this line in the game's credits.

## What is in the project

- `Satie/`: the scene as you keep it (`scene.satie`, `samples.json`, `scene.contract.json`). Commit it.
- `Packages/world.satie.unity`: the Satie package (the component, the mixer window, the native libraries). Commit it.
- `Assets/Resources/SatieCore`: the compiled scene the component loads. Commit it, or compile again after a checkout.
- `.satie/`: the take cache and the mixer's log. Not committed.

Nothing is assigned in the editor: press Play and a `Satie` object starts by itself. Satie decides what sounds, when and how loud, rings the rooms and muffles what is behind a wall; Unity's panning, or the spatializer your headset SDK ships (Project Settings, Audio, Spatializer Plugin), gives each sound its direction.

Build targets with a native library: Windows x64, macOS, Linux x64 and Android arm64 (Quest and phones). On any other target (iOS, WebGL, consoles) the scene is silent for now.

## Binding

A sound written `at <host>` follows the object with that name (`GameObject.Find`). When the name differs, bind it yourself: `SatieCore.Bind("door", door.transform)`. A host that is never found plays at the position the manifest gave, and the console says so once. Positions are your own world coordinates, unchanged.

## Telling the sound what happens

Add `using Satie.Core;` to the script that makes these calls.

| What happened | Call |
| --- | --- |
| An event at a place | `SatieCore.Fire("door_open", position)` |
| An event from a host | `SatieCore.HostEvent("crate", "drop")` |
| The ground under a host changed | `SatieCore.SetHostSurface("player", "gravel")` (before the event) |
| A continuous control moved | `SatieCore.Signal("engine_load", 0.7f)` |
| The game changed mode | `SatieCore.State("combat")`, `SatieCore.State(null)` |

Events this scene answers: `step` (surfaces: snow), `kid_step` (surfaces: snow), `scoop` (surfaces: snow), `kid_scoop` (surfaces: snow), `throw`, `snowball_hit`, `snowball_hit_player`, `punch_hit`, `shutter`, `print_eject`, `photo_drop`, `kid_stunned`.

States: `menu`, `investigating`, `snowball_fight`, `chase`, `case_closed`.

## Mixing, and changing the sound

Window > Satie > Mixer lists every sound while the game plays: its level, volume, mute and solo, the signals and the states. Save writes your decisions to `.satie/authoring/edits.jsonl`. Then run the install line again without `--from` (or keep it running with `--watch`): the decisions go into `Satie/scene.satie`, the scene is compiled again and a playing editor reloads it. To change what the scene is, compose again in Satie and export again.

## Synthesizer voices

This scene has no synth loop.

## What Unity does not get

- `count`: a voice written as several copies is exported once.
- Event voices overlap: a new fire does not cut the previous one.
- Build targets other than Windows x64, macOS, Linux x64 and Android arm64 (Quest and phones): the package has no native library for them yet, so the scene is silent there.
